about: Every published data file needs an entry: its sources and what it contains. tools/audit_public.py reads this file. Flags: iea_figures = contains IEA-derived figures (confirm IEA terms before the repo goes public); iea_quotes = quotes short IEA wording; secondary_article_figures = figures from secondary articles (attributed); lme_statistics_only = statistics derived from licensed LME data, never LME values; large_ok = a derived series with 100 or more rows that was checked on purpose.

results/res_dollar_correlations.csv.note: derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested)

results/res_dollar_regressions.csv.note: derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested)

results/res_dollar_stability_by_period.c.note: derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested)

results/res_dollar_rolling_correlation_3.note: monthly rolling correlations (derived, 296 rows); derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested)

results/res_dollar_lead_lag.csv.note: derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested)

results/res_dollar_cpi_sensitivity.csv.note: derived statistics from World Bank commodity prices (CC BY 4.0) and FRED series (public domain, citation requested); CPI from BLS via FRED

results/res_dollar_month_end_check.csv.note: correlations and coefficients only; no LME price values (the LME data is licensed and never published)

results/res_cu_al_threshold_table.csv.note: results by threshold on World Bank prices (CC BY 4.0)

results/res_demand_context.csv.note: USGS mine and refinery output; S13 reported figures; model figure built from an IEA capacity number

copper_database/collected/copper_intensi.note: copper per vehicle quoted from a secondary article, attributed

copper_database/collected/known_issues.c.note: known issues; K01 states IT-vs-total differences computed from the IEA annex

copper_database/collected/scenario_assum.note: project assumptions; the base-year build (14 GW, 9.25 GW) is computed from IEA capacity numbers

copper_database/baselines/fred_monthly_p.note: per-series counts, dates and sums of the old aluminium and CPI tables (aggregates only)

copper_database/baselines/usgs_copper_py.note: aggregates of USGS copper data (US government work)

copper_database/baselines/wb_prices_mont.note: per-commodity counts, dates and sums (aggregates only); World Bank (CC BY 4.0)

notebooks/01_copper_vs_dollar.ipynb.note: outputs show derived statistics; the month-end section shows correlations from LME data without any LME price values
